text: Very cool. I really love Natural natural wood and bringing in some of the outdoors into my home as decoration. This is a wonderful birch Holder But the seem Needed to be glued as It was beginning to curl up Unblock from the Holder. It came with a very nice shaped clear jar inside that I used to put rocks and stones in To display. The birch part I put Artificial Flowers in..

product_metadata.title: Serene Spaces Living Small White Birch Bark Vase with Glass Interior, Decorative Centerpiece, Rustic Accent Piece, Ideal for Natural Wedding Tablescape, Vintage Home Decor, 4.5" Diameter & 4.5" Tall
features: RUSTIC WOOD DECOR - Add a rustic touch to your wedding, anniversary, and home with our natural birch vase. Suitable for a wide range of decorative styles, including country, tropical, and modern.

NATURAL BIRCH BARK - This natural container has a birch bark exterior and a clear glass interior, making it adorable and durable. Made of natural wood, each vase will vary slightly in texture, pattern, and color.

VERSATILE VASE - You can place floating tea lights or a pillar candle and have a relaxing candlelight dinner with your loved ones. Or, arrange flowers and succulents in it for an exquisite tablescape.
DÉCOR TIPS - Create a woodland vibe by pairing it with our birchwood vases, available in various shapes and sizes, and placing them under your Christmas tree.

PERFECTLY SIZED - Sold individually, the birch vase measures 4.5" Diameter & 4.5" Tall. You can count on quality, design, and manufacturing when you order from Serene Spaces Living, where we make everything with love.
